patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Elastic Observability share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose AppDynamics only if your buying job matches “Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33” rather than Elastic Observability's shape. Choose Elastic Observability only if your buying job matches “Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB / 2 zones); Serverles” rather than AppDynamics's shape. Workflow advantage differs because AppDynamics is shaped for Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium ( whereas Elastic Observability is shaped for Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB /. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AppDynamics and Elastic Observability share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: AppDynamics is Cisco APM / observability — Infrastructure from ~$6/vCPU/mo; Premium (infra+apps) from $33/vCPU/mo annual; Enterprise $50/vCPU; often Cisco ; Elastic Observability is Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB / 2 zones); Serverless Observability usage from ~$0.07–$0.09/GB ingest;.
- Company-size focus: AppDynamics (mid-market, enterprise) vs Elastic Observability (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: AppDynamics — Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); Elastic Observability — This entity is Elastic Observability on Cloud — not “Elasticsearch search product only”.

Limitations — AppDynamics: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); $6/vCPU Infrastructure is not the APM-relevant floor — Premium $33 is; Elastic Observability: This entity is Elastic Observability on Cloud — not “Elasticsearch search product only”; $99 Hosted Standard is a small 120 GB / 2-zone floor; real TCO follows resources.

Poor-fit cases: AppDynamics is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6) · Elastic Observability is a poor fit when that limitation bites: This entity is Elastic Observability on Cloud — not “Elasticsearch search product only” · Avoid AppDynamics if you actually need Elastic Observability's motion (Observability on Elastic Cloud — Hosted Standard from $99/mo (120 GB / 2 zones);)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
